reviews.text: Great, Simple Tracker!. I’ve been using Lose It on and off for the past 10 years. I used to weight a little over 290 lbs and was able to reach my goal weight of 190 lbs by keeping track of my macros, workout frequency, and water intake. It was nice being able to see my progress over time and logging each day felt rewarding most of the time instead of a chore. I think the simplicity of the application adds to that. Most other apps can be overbearing, intrusive, or overload you with needless amounts of information that perhaps might not be relevant to your goals. We all want a healthy lifestyle, that’s why we’re here, and Lose It is a great choice to achieve that.

Long ago, I had been using a different app that I won’t name because I found it easier to use then then current version of Lose It! 

Between an injury and Covid era I fell off the diet gained a significant amount of weight. By December 2022 I was at 323 pounds 😳 My doctor got me on Mounjaro. After two weeks on that i realized I really needed to track what I was eating. And that other app had added all sorts of bells and whistles that I found useless and made it difficult to use. So I tried Lose It! again. To my surprise, I found it quite easy to use, and more importantly I was able to do things such as create custom foods and recipe recipes.

As I like to do most of my own cooking, frequently from scratch, that feature of being able to create a recipe is fantastic! As a for instance, last night I had homemade sourdough pizza. I was able to create a recipe with the exact measurements of each ingredient I used and come up with what looks like a very accurate estimate of the calories each serving. 

My only negative on the app relates to items in the food database where the quantity just says “serving” instead of a definitive volume or weight (fairly sure these are items added/shared by other uses). For custom foods (and those in the database I’ve edited) I always attempt to include a weight and a volume… I find weighing to be far more accurate than measuring volume!

Best Calorie Tracker. I’ve lost 30+ pounds using this app. I have the lifetime version now. I have used other trackers before and this one is my favorite.

G. New update sucks

reviews.text: Always success. Every time I use lose it I’m successful in losing weight and achieving my goal! It works and keeps me motivated and accountable!
Lost 62 pounds and counting. I owe much credit to this app and its ability to keep me accountable with accurate data. Have recommended this app to several friends and will continue to do so.

Best way to keep track of my weight. I love this app! It helps me every time I want to lose weight. Keeps me on track by not eating too much. When I step on the scale and see my weight go down little by little I feel like I’m actually losing weight. It puts a smile on my face.
Good but overpriced. Would not pay $80 a year for this app

AMAZING Tool. I’ve lost almost 55lbs with tracking my food using this app. It’s so helpful and has become easy, I don’t even think about it. I’m a happy customer and recommend it to all folks looking to loose some lbs.

Long time user with positive results. I’ve been on Lose It for a while. It’s essential to keep track of my calories so I don’t slide back to where I was before. I use it to count calories and it remembers my previous meals and foods eaten…everything I need for fast and easy record keeping.

Far Above my Expectations. This is by far the best free Calorie Tracking App out there. It’s actually free to use all of its core/basic features. Highly recommend.

reviews.text: Ease. So easy to use
Love this app. I really enjoy this app! It’s really been a big help to my weight loss!

Annoying. The only thing I can think of that could be more annoying than a pop up ad after you enter each food item just because I won’t pay for features I don’t need is that now the ads don’t even load, you just get the spinning icon forever. Workaround is swipe out and get back in after every entry.

Just the basics is great. I first used this app in my 20’s when I wanted to get a defined body. It was eye opening. I was very athletic and it helped me be more disciplined about what foods I would eat to actually fuel my body. Everyone should calorie count at least once in their life. Certain foods just weren’t worth it because just going to Five Guys was my entire calorie budget… I still ate junk when I wanted to but would cut what I could, settle for the burger and not the fries or soda. Now in my 30’s the fat sticks. I’m trying to clean up my diet, preserve muscle mass as I age and lose the unattractive fat. I redownloaded the app and i love being able to track my protein intake as well. I was not getting enough and although losing fat I was also losing muscle. I did try my fitness pal because everyone raved about it then they had a data leak. Regrets haha Lose it, just the basics is perfect for my needs. Great app, thank you! Much preferred over other popular trackers. This app has been wonderful for my weight loss and doing it in a healthy manner. Skinny isn’t the goal, healthy and fit is.

Get it!!!. I got this app over 10 years ago to help me lose weight. Smartest thing I’ve ever done. Got it when it was free. Liked it so much I upgraded, then paid for the premium. I’ve lost over 60 pounds and have kept it off since then. So easy to use. The upgrades have been great. Helps me keep track of everything I need to stay at my weight. Highly recommend this app. By the way I’m 85 years old, so don’t worry if it’s to difficult to use.
Nose dive!. This was an amazing app until they moved all the features behind a paywall, and not just a paywall, a monthly subscription. I’m ditching it after years of using it.

The B-radshow. The best app I’ve ever used. This has so much data that you can practically look up any food to track your calories. It’s very convenient and has a memory making it easier to plug in yesterday macros. If you’re having trouble finding the right app, this one here is a sure winner! Enjoy!😄

Concern!. Very concerned with TEMU ads that show up if do not have subscription. Ads always show little girls (block of 4 pics)suggestively posed and dressed. I reported it twice to Loose It organization and to a monitoring company. The ads are unsettling. They must drop Temu. I really like the ease of calorie counting in the app, but because of ads, I’m searching for new app.

The Best App. I’ve been using this app for over a decade and will have it forever. Easy to use, they make it better every year. It not only helps with “counting calories”, but the best is getting a full picture of my overall health and nutrition. I also love to cook, and appreciate being able to create recipes and serving sizes. Excellent app.
My food list will not stay deleted.. I like most things about this app but I can’t seem to edit my list of foods. Some of them I have deleted many times but when I check, there they are again.
Has everything. Nice interface, huge database, modern UI. Would be nice if it was possible to make the UI even more minimalist.

reviews.text:
Turned to goop… Fixed and back to gold. After working with Ryan from the Lose It team, all my issues were resolved. I have this updated my rating of the app. Keep up the good work, guys. 
See below:
It was once a great app, then they kept mucking with it on a daily basis. First time I’m writing a review, even though I’ve been using this app for more than 5 years on a daily basis. It hangs and freezes in a daily basis. It was not like this before. Too many useless changes to the code. I uninstalled the app and reinstalled it, to no avail, except I lost over 3,000 day streak. I’m regretting paying for lifetime-premium so many years ago… this is no longer a premium app.
Frustrated with update!. I have loved this app for years and years, but recently updates cause it to freeze, include seemingly unnecessary changes and it has become much less user friendly.

Hate this “new” version. I am well over 3000 days of tracking and I’m hating this “new“ version! Every time I try to search for meals it crashes, it’s very unintuitive, it’s hard to add things quickly and simply like it used to be so easy and now it’s stupid. I’m miserable but I’m already invested over 3000 days so I guess I’m stuck!

Terrible updates. I’m so sick of these so-called updates. I’ve been using this app for over ten years and they have just ruined it. Put the dang plus button back. It’s suck a hassle adding food by having to scroll around this slow UI. My workouts are now broken too. When I try to add a workout I did from the previous day, it’s just zeros on calories burned in the summary. Then I have to manually enter the time and distance when I run or do anything. It’s very annoying. These developers are terrible and so are the managers who keep pushing this terrible changes. Test your dang code before you release it and listen to your customers.
Gold Standard. A great app with just a few irritants. Helps me keep my protein up and carbs down. Constant pop ups to upgrade but the basic is free for I get it.

Really comprehensive health management app. I tried this app on the advice of a friend. I have tried a couple of other training apps that had calorie counting, but this app is far and way better than anything. I even imagined it is so easy to add your meals and control your plan. It does so many more things than just count calories. My only wish is there was support for Hume data. I have the Hume band and Hume pod, and neither is supported currently. I do get some data from my device devices through Apple health, which is supported.. Also Apple Watch is supported. I don’t regret purchasing this app, in fact, I think it’s one of the better app purchase I’ve ever made

Fan until April 2026. I’ve used the app for more than 10 years and was pleased until an update was done in April 2026. This update is NOT user friendly - logging now takes a minimum of 2-3 times longer than before the update. A system that was effortless to stay consistent is a ridiculous time drain. Not happy, nit even content
The snap it feature. Doesn’t really work that well

Lost 60 pounds in a year. It took time and will power but in the course of one year using the Lose It app helped me stay focused and on track to lose 60 pounds. It takes willpower and motivation to stay steady and committed to your goals and the app helps with awareness of what you’re consuming and it is very useful to see the trend over time to know you are on track.

App resets after extended periods.. I want to use the app to establish a meal plan, not necessarily to track daily intakes. Frankly, it’s GREAT for that! It tracks macros well, I love being able to create recipes, and the catalog of foods and barcode scanner are super convenient! 

However, because I use it so infrequently (every other month or so to tweak my meal plan) I often come back to the app and it *forces* me to go through the initial plan establishment process. This is super frustrating when all I want to do is modify my meal plan. 

Please allow for disabling this function. Thank you.

Pretty good option for daily calorie consumption and burning. I have been using the app for many years now. The free version as I feel that the subscription is too expensive and not something that I actually have to have. I found a glitch in their latest update, contacted them and they responded in an expedited manner. They fixed the glitch in a couple days. Nice to see a customer service that actually does what they say.

App will freeze while trying to add meals.. I used to love this app but it freezes up almost every day now. Very frustrating because it never used to do that. Have to close and reopen once if not more. May have to find another app that is more user friendly.

Does what is needed but a little quirky. Easy to use app for tracking food intake. Love that it has a barcode scanner! It is easy to link recipes or input ingredients for folks like me who like to cook. Syncs smoothly with Fitbit and allows for manual input of various activities or workouts. The quirky: it reports patterns in your eating, but doesn’t identify the health component. Ex: it notices that calorie count is lower when I include maple syrup in my meal, rather than the high fiber, high protein foods I am eating in those meals. It also counts pounds lost but not fluctuations, so it thinks goal has been reached even if there has been a plateau. If you can live with these quirks it’s a great little app.

Loovveeee. I absolutely LOVE this app. It's easy to navigate, easy to customize. I can change my goals every day if I wanted to (and sometimes I do lol). I did pay for a subscription when they had a sale, because I'm lazy and I like to scan the barcodes for my food. But you can do PLENTY without paying, and it's so helpful. This is the longest I have stuck to my goals, and I'm down 30 lbs this year so far because of consistency!
Free and all you need. Free versión will do but the premium is amazing and cheaper than others.

Very good tool for when you are really ready to shed pounds. This app does a very good job of tracking both intake and output with accurate calorie counts and accurate exercise integration. I’ve used it twice and have shed over 30 pounds and gotten in the best shape of my life. Highly recommend.

Paid yet still getting ads, ui worsened. New update got rid of the option to permanently hide the “gonift” ad. (reason for one star)

Made the second most used feature weight logging way more annoying to access.
(Three stars)

reviews.text: Stop making useless changes. Where is my PINK theme? Stop making useless unnecessary changes when I’m a PREMIUM member.

Simple, easy, and BEYOND Useful. This is my go to and most recommended app in general. Yes, there is a subscription that unlocks AMAZING features, but if you ever get the chance to be a lifetime subscriber, take it and reap the INSANE benefits of complete tracking. Get it, ASAP!

All In One. I started using this app about a year, maybe two years ago. Since then, I have lost 60 plus pounds. Each update, this app get better and better and easier to use and customize. I love it so much I got the lifetime membership.

Better until purchases. This app was so incredibly helpful in weight loss. It’s sleek and easy to understand. Taking away the barcode scanner from the free version was honestly a downgrade for me and made the app just more annoying to use.
Cjstyles. Love “Lose It-Calorie Counter” It’s my go-to App to get back on track!
Took away personalization. Why the hell did you guys take away our themes?! Why am I now stuck staring at a bright orange background with your app??? I’m deleting it!

Constantly changes the food metrics even for foods you eat regularly. The app constantly changes the measurements for the foods I scan in without warning. For example, the bread I eat regularly originally scanned as "calories per slice." The package even gives the serving as "one slice." A couple of weeks later "slice" was gone as an option, with only "ounces" or "grams" available. This is ridiculous, and it happens all the time. Just tonight I went into enter something that I always measure in "cups" to find it had been replaced by "ounces" and "grams." The package gives sevings in cups.
It would be a whole lot easier if the developers would just use the portion on the product label, it's tiresome having to convert or get out a scale to weigh a slice of bread. Give me a break!
Good accountability. This app has helped me stay accountable and lose weight. I’ve kept it off. Highly recommend.

DISAPPOINTED!!! Greedy Changes. I’ve been using this app consistently since 2023. I took a break for a couple months from calorie tracking as I was only maintaining my weight but I would continue to update my weight in app. However, I recently opened the app back up for calorie tracking purposes only to discover that several features that I heavily relied on are suddenly placed behind a paywall. I’m really frustrated with this outcome as a college student who always struggled to manage my health as well as the stress of being a student. The app was the only thing that made it easy by allowing me to scan barcodes of food items I’ve purchased as well as view my overall macros for the day. I understand that the app needs to make money but there are various premium features that made sense to pay extra for previously and this did not need to be taken away from loyal users. Now, the bare essentials for the app are inaccessible and I’m incredibly disappointed. I dislike any app that makes the free tier nearly useless. I’m hoping for this to be reversed but it is highly unlikely. The yearly rate for this membership is 80 dollars which is incredibly ridiculous and greedy. Although there is currently a sale I don’t see these “updates” as reasonable personally. I understand this may be worth it for some people but as someone who felt blindsided by the switch I don’t know how to justify a purchase like this. I’ve fortunately seen other people agree with me. Do better.

Great calorie counting app. This app has been a big help for my journey. You can basically look up any food restaurant, grocery store brand, and it will find how many calories is in a serving for you. You can record your weight daily. The premium version has a lot of extras like water tracking macros and micros . Overall i like it
